activationAuthority.record: FrameworkActivation { package, framework, state: active | inactive | unsupported-version | off, admittedRelease, mode, provenance }
activationAuthority.scope: per workspace package, published per PM snapshot

row.admission: the PM-resolved installed ember-source version of the owning package equals an admittedReleases[].version in glimmer-version-lock.json
row.switch: frameworks.ember-glimmer = auto | off | { state: on, release: <exact release> } (CFG0)

states.when: auto or on, and the resolved installed ember-source version is admitted
auto and the owning package does not resolve ember-source
ember-source resolves to a version not in admittedReleases (including 7.x and any beta or alpha), or on names an unadmitted release
states.work: zero, plus an unsupported report naming the version and the excluded-release reason

states.when: the package or its installed version is not yet resolved by PM
states.work: zero; never cached as a warm negative and never replaced by a name-based guess (DEM0 DR24)

row.capabilityBit: an active record sets the ember-glimmer ProjectCapabilitySnapshot bit for the owning package

forbiddenActivationSources.source: a declared package.json range without a resolved install

forbiddenActivationSources.reason: the detection package is ember-source only
LK6 selects which lint.ember packs run; it is a consumer of FWA1, never an activation source for the vertical

forbiddenActivationSources.source: the GLM1G TextMate grammar or client-side colouring
forbiddenActivationSources.reason: client-side lexical colouring is not a Verter activation

forbiddenActivationSources.source: any second record type or per-node activation predicate beside FrameworkActivation
forbiddenActivationSources.reason: FWA1 is the only activation source

abortCheck.condition: FWA1 cannot express a per-package, version-admitted ember-source activation
abortCheck.observed: not triggered: the FWA1 charter publishes one FrameworkActivation per package and file per PM snapshot, admits by the resolved installed version against this lock, and DEM0 DR01 makes that record the only activation input
